title: ee.search.document.v1
description: One result document emitted in data.results[] by ee search JSON output. This schema pins the public search-result document contract separately from the enclosing ee.response.v2 command envelope.

memoryId.description: Present when docId names an ee memory row.

relevanceScore.description: Deterministic 0..1 relevance projection for agent interpretation. NOT a calibrated probability and NOT comparable across queries or across sources unless `calibrated` is true. Hybrid/RRF scores are rescaled from their small raw magnitude, cosine similarities are clamped to positive similarity, and a lexical-only BM25 pool is min-max normalized against a synthetic zero-evidence reference — which maps that pool's strongest hit to exactly 1.0 whatever its raw BM25 was. Read `lexicalScore` for the raw engine value behind a lexical hit. Tracked by bd-reality-core-convergence-1azkt.11.

scoreKind.description: Interpretation tag for score, naming WHAT PRODUCED the value rather than asserting a property of it. `query_relative_pool_minmax` is reported for a lexical-only score: min-max normalized over the RETURNED POOL against a synthetic zero-evidence reference, which maps that pool's strongest hit to exactly 1.0 whatever its raw BM25 was. `query_relative` says the value is not comparable across queries; `pool` names the denominator, because min-max over the retrieved pool is a different number from min-max over the corpus. Raw BM25 remains in lexicalScore. Renamed from `unit_normalized` by bd-reality-core-convergence-1azkt.11, which was a claim about the output and could be read as a calibrated unit-interval score. Cosine, RRF, and reranker scores retain their native ranking scale.

calibrationId.description: Stable identity of the exact score-calibration regime/evidence applied to this hit. Null only when calibration metadata is unavailable.

coverageGuarantee.description: Calibrated coverage probability for scoreInterval (e.g. 0.95). Null when `calibrated` is false: scoreInterval is the trivial [0,1] band and coverage is unknown rather than 95%.

calibrated.description: True when a conformal residual quantile produced scoreInterval/coverageGuarantee around relevanceScore. When false, scoreInterval is the trivial [0,1] band.

metadata.description: Public, redaction-filtered search metadata copied from the indexed document.

driftHint.description: Optional drift-hint payload copied from metadata when present.

meshTrustAdjustment.description: Optional trust-adjustment payload copied from mesh metadata when present.

content.description: Redaction-safe top-level memory body preview. The forbidden contentPreview synonym is never emitted.

content_truncated.description: True only when content was shortened to the bounded search preview.
